lead_raw_text:
The structure of CoRhP₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—Co₂Rh₂P₄—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Rh each coordinated by eight P neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while P has ten geometric neighbors (four Co, three P, and three Rh). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between P-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Co- and P-centered polyhedra.
